records.reviewNotes: Official implementing regulation source. Product/service routing must distinguish internal decision-support analytics from regulated brokerage/services activity before any compliance claim is made.
Official CMA regulation establishes purpose-specific valuation controls for real-estate investment funds. It must be routed only when the case falls within the relevant CMA fund context.

Official ZATCA source verifies current RETT law and rate. Tax treatment remains transaction- and exemption-specific and must not be hard-coded as universally payable without routing the actual transaction facts.
Use the current official implementing-rule text for rule extraction before coding exemption, timing or liability logic. This evidence record verifies the authority page, not every detailed tax rule.

verifiedConclusions: REGA maintains active primary legislation and implementing regulations for real-estate brokerage and covered real-estate services.
CMA real-estate investment-fund regulations contain purpose-specific accredited-valuer, independence, report-content and report-age requirements.
ZATCA's current official RETT law source states a 5% tax rate and an effective date of 2025-04-10 for the current law.
SOCPA provides Saudi endorsement documents for international accounting/auditing standards and Saudi endorsement may include local modifications or additional requirements.
SDAIA publishes the PDPL and its executive regulations on the official National Data Governance Platform.
SAMA's rulebook confirms SAMA's statutory regulation of the real-estate finance sector and its authority to issue sector standards/procedures.
